halfyearly.label: Report cards
halfyearly.hint: A report card for every student with marks, grades, percentage and rank, and a rank list first.

withpass.label: With pass or fail
withpass.hint: Adds a Pass or Fail result using the pass mark you set. Failed subjects show in red.

grades.label: Grades only
grades.hint: Shows only the grade for each subject and no marks, for classes that report grades.

ranks.label: Rank list only
ranks.hint: Only the class rank list, with totals, percentages and grades.
